fact: On 11 December 2022 the Ministry of the Interior put into service a four-level computerised system (commune, daira, central administration) to monitor each commune's financial position monthly, including revenue recovery; it is a national system owned by the Ministry (no count of communes given).
title: Suivi de la situation financière des communes : mise en service d'un système informatisé
publisher: Algérie Eco (citing Ministry of the Interior communiqué)
